godless.linePrev: These mammals are hell-bent on fashioning new gods
godless.line: So they can go on being godless animals
stanza: Their languages just serve to confuse them
Their confusion somehow makes them more sure
They build fortunes poisoning their offspring
And hand out prizes when someone patents a cure
Where did they find these goons they elected to rule them?
What makes these clowns they idolize so remarkable?
These mammals are hell-bent on fashioning new gods
So they can go on being godless animals

godless.linePrev: Since some liar brought the thunder
godless.line: When the land was godless and free
godless.lineNext: Her eyes look sharp and steady
stanza: Since some liar brought the thunder
When the land was godless and free
Her eyes look sharp and steady
Into the empty parts of me
With the hate of some other man's beliefs
